name: Kleinmachnow (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kleinmachnow (a blue pavilion and two black hooks on white).
history: Municipal flag of Kleinmachnow; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
